# Finnish cuisine — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What are the staple foods of Finnish cuisine?", "rye, fish, potatoes, berries"),
    ("Name a signature dish of Finnish cuisine.", "Karjalanpiirakka"),
    ("What is region?", "Finland"),
    ("What is staples?", "rye, fish, potatoes, berries"),
    ("What is signature dish 1?", "Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian pies)"),
    ("What is signature dish 2?", "Kalakukko (fish bread loaf)"),
    ("What is signature dish 3?", "Lohikeitto (salmon soup)"),
    ("What is signature dish 4?", "Poronkäristys (sautéed reindeer)"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
